summary: CLI app to create feedback forms, distribute them by email/social media, collect responses and analyse them with charts and insights.

features.name: Form management
features.details: Create, list, view, update and delete forms with ordered questions

features.name: Response collection
features.details: Validate and store responses with channel and timestamp

features.name: Email distribution
features.details: Invitation emails saved to an outbox; optional SMTP
acceptance: one email per address with link tagged channel=email

features.name: Social sharing
acceptance: three links, each tagged with its channel

features.name: Persistence
acceptance: CSV export then import keeps responses

features.name: Analytics
features.details: Averages, distribution, NPS, channels, sentiment, keywords

features.name: Trends
features.details: Count and average rating per day/week/month

features.name: Insights
acceptance: flags low ratings, negative NPS, declining trend, complaint keywords

features.name: Visualization and CLI
features.details: SVG bar/line charts, text charts, argparse CLI with friendly errors
acceptance: CLI returns 1 with 'Error:' message on bad id
